title: Execution of James the Just, brother of Jesus, under High Priest Ananus ben Ananus
note: Attested by Josephus in Antiquities 20.9.1 as the brother of Jesus called Christ, marking the leadership crisis of the early Jerusalem community prior to the First Jewish-Roman War.

title: Mary Magdalene
note: Leading female disciple from Magdala, prominent financial patron and principal recorded witness of the crucifixion, burial, and resurrection appearances across the canonical Gospels.

title: Conversion of King Ezana of Aksum to Christianity
note: Earliest state adoption of Christianity in Sub-Saharan Africa; attested by Ezana's trilingual Ge'ez/Greek/Sabaean stelae and gold coinages replacing the disc-and-crescent with the Christian cross.

title: Establishment of Saint Thomas Christian communities along the Malabar Coast
note: Traces the maritime transmission of Christianity to Kerala via Indian Ocean Roman-era trade networks, establishing the ancient Syriac-rite Nasrani traditions in South Asia.
